entry_points.text: Inline Adler helper folds input in bounded chunks with prime reduction, returns initial value on null input and uses wide then scalar tails.

exports.text: Streaming contexts alias one-shot contexts as one object; dictionary handles and parameter storage are opaque forward types.
Header provides a static-linking guard and equates static API visibility with shared visibility.
Interface offers small integer aliases, running-check callback, native register alias, opaque allocation callbacks and maximal-size error sentinel.

hazards.text: Experimental ids are unstable and static-link only; threading knobs without thread build fail; block-size target is a latency hint; threaded flush/end may block.
Compression ids use 104-107, 130, 160-164, 200-202, 400-402 plus experimental slots; decompression uses 100 plus 1000-1005; reset 1-3, end 0-2.
Stable compression names alias slots 1-20, including rsyncable, format, stable buffers and max block; block-splitter maximum is level 6.
Stable decompression names alias slots 1-6, including format, stable output and max block size.
Window/hash/chain/search/match/overlap keep documented caps with 32/64-bit limits; header sizes bounded; deflate 0-2, match 3-258, dict bit 0x20, OS 3, Adler prime 65521 chunk 5552.
Word width derives from long or fixes at 32, long long at 64; base errors 1-34 and extended 35-134 share aliases for blocked, deadlock, bad message and corruption.
Low two bits encode access mode; higher bits hold create and behaviour flags through path/tmpfile combos, with no-delay aliasing nonblock.
File control codes assign small numbers to duplicate, query and lock operations including open-description forms; close-on-exec and lock kinds use small fixed values.
Huge sizes encode log values at shift 26 under mask 0x3F; ioctl packs 8-bit number, 8-bit type, 14-bit size and 2-bit direction upward from bit zero.
Classic terminal controls occupy 0x5401-0x5429 with input-queue alias.
Extended controls mix fixed codes and type-T transfers with termios/serial payloads; packet mode reports flush, stop/start and ioctl events with empty marker 0x01.
Protections and mappings combine read, none, fixed, anonymous and hugetlb modes with future locking; advice spans normal, dontneed and poison handling.
Tick 100, exec page 4096, nogroup -1, hostname 64; poll uses low hex bits for input, output, error and hangup.

Referenced dicts must outlive users; magicless frames need explicit mode; skipping checksums drops integrity; stable buffers forbid mutation; null Adler yields initial value; lock/permission/queue layouts vary by build.

invariants.text: Input and output cursors stay within zero to size inclusive and move forward to record consumed input and produced output.
All-zero sequence marks a block boundary; zero offset with zero match length carries trailing literals of the given literal length.
Zero means default; tunables clamp to ranges; long-distance grows memory/window; headers default to size and dict id without checksum; workers gate async/job/overlap; overlap 0-9 scales load.
Decoder rejects oversize windows unless raised; dicts auto-detect magic or force raw/full with copy/reference; framing, checksum, attach, literal and tri-state selectors choose behaviour.
Small widths map to char pairs with sixty-four bit as long long; kernel long, pid, user and group map to long, int and unsigned int.
Direction none/write/read/combined places fields; checked builders derive size from type; decoders recover direction, number and size.
Sampled generic headers each define one inclusion guard to prevent repeated processing.

locks.text: Flock holds shared or exclusive, combines nonblock to avoid waiting, releases explicitly, and supports mandatory and read/write modes; vendor codes start at 1024.

state_machines.text: Encoding ends via continue collecting, flush emitting decodable blocks keeping history, then end closing the frame; reset clears session, parameters or both.
Decoder input cycles header, block, final, checksum and skippable; sequence production uses optional delimiters with all-set failure; margin reserves header, checksum, per-block and one block.

structs.text: Bounds result pairs an error flag with inclusive lower and upper parameter limits.
Input buffer holds read-only base, extent and read cursor; output holds writable base, extent and write cursor.
Sequence holds offset, literal length, match length and a zero-to-three repeat selector whose meaning shifts when literal length is zero.
Compression aggregate joins window, chain, hash, search, match, target and strategy with content-size, checksum and dict-id frame toggles.
Frame header record reports content size with unknown/empty distinct, bounded window, max block, normal versus skippable kind, header length, dict id and checksum flag.
Allocation pairs opaque allocate/release with context defaulting to libc; threading hides a pool and counts ingested, consumed, produced and flushed bytes with job and worker ids.
Owner exception holds type selecting thread/process/group plus pid; lock records hold type, whence, start, length and owner pid with native versus 64-bit offsets.
Permission holds key, ids, mode, pad, sequence and reserves; queue adds timestamps, counts and pids; poll holds descriptor and requested/returned masks.
